$comment: Copy to ./dani-tools.config.json or ~/.config/dani-tools/config.json — every field is optional. Precedence: --model flag > OLLAMA_MODEL env > this file > built-in default. Prompt overrides replace the tool's ENTIRE system prompt — keep the output-format instructions or the parsers will have nothing to chew on.

threadsmith.system: You convert long-form content into viral Twitter/X threads in the style of a sharp indie hacker: first person, concrete numbers, zero buzzwords. Each tweet under 280 characters including the numbering prefix. Hook hard in tweet 1. One idea per tweet. Output the thread and nothing else.
